title: Genuine Tripartite Entanglement Selects Gauge-Invariant Theories
summary: Recent studies have explored whether physical constants and symmetries can be selected by extremizing bipartite entanglement entropy. We extend this approach to a three-particle setting. Specifically, we consider a $2+1$-particle system in which particles $B$ and $C$ are initially entangled, and then particles $A$ and $B$ scatter without the direct participation of particle $C$ for both gluon-gluon and graviton-graviton scatterings.
